{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Treatment response in non-injected target lesions' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Treatment response in non-injected target lesions based on RECIST v1.1 by BICR",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This secondary endpoint is listed but no corresponding analysis is described in the statistical methods section. The exploratory analyses mention noninjected target lesions but only per itRECIST, not RECIST v1.1 by BICR.",
      "fix": "Add a specific analysis for this endpoint in the efficacy analyses section, including estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This PK endpoint is listed but no PK analysis methods are described in the statistical section. The statistical methods section does not include any PK analysis details.",
      "fix": "Add a PK analysis subsection describing the derivation of PK parameters, summary statistics, and any modeling."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Development of anti-Qb antibodies' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Development of anti-Qb antibodies",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no analysis is described in the statistical methods section. No immunogenicity analysis is mentioned.",
      "fix": "Add an immunogenicity analysis subsection describing the summary of anti-Qb antibody development and any statistical methods."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoint 'Change from Baseline in blood concentrations of CXCL10 and other cytokines' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Change from Baseline in blood concentrations of CXCL10 (interferon gamma-induced protein 10) and other cytokines after treatment with CMP-001",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This exploratory endpoint is listed but no analysis is described in the statistical methods section. The exploratory analyses only mention tumor biopsy biomarkers, not blood cytokines.",
      "fix": "Add an analysis for this endpoint in the exploratory analyses section, including the estimand and handling of missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint estimand lacks explicit intercurrent events and summary measure",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of the study is the ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR).",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary estimand is not fully specified. The population is implied (ITT) but intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death, missing assessments) and the summary measure (proportion) are not explicitly defined in the endpoint description. The statistical section does not provide a formal estimand framework.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand for the primary endpoint including population, variable, intercurrent event handling (e.g., treatment policy, composite), and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size section is incomplete and lacks key inputs",
      "quote": "A sample size of 69 subjects achieves at least 80% power to detect a difference of 13% using",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The sample size justification is cut off mid-sentence and does not specify the null hypothesis, the expected response rate, the alpha level, or the statistical test used. This is a critical gap for regulatory review.",
      "fix": "Complete the sample size section with full details: null and alternative response rates, alpha, power, test (e.g., exact binomial), and any assumptions."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing data handling is not described for any endpoint",
      "quote": "A detailed statistical analysis plan (SAP) will be finalized before database lock and will document the analysis methods, data handling procedures, and other statistical analysis issues.",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol defers all data handling to the SAP without providing any primary or sensitivity analysis for missing data. This is a gap because the protocol should at least outline the approach for key endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add a section on missing data handling for primary and key secondary endpoints, including sensitivity analyses."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity adjustment for secondary endpoints is not described",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints of the study are:",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Multiple secondary endpoints are listed, but the statistical methods section does not describe any multiplicity control strategy (e.g., hierarchical testing, Bonferroni). This could lead to inflated type I error.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection on multiplicity control for secondary endpoints, specifying the testing hierarchy or adjustment method."
    }
  ]
}
